qualification: Unmodified pinned component and independent synthetic geometry only; no game data, live dispatch, original caller integration or solved-level claim.

normalization.tuples: JSON arrays, preserving element order and all scalar values
normalization.sets: Sorted lexicographically by Python value; set iteration is not a semantic order
normalization.tupleKeyDictionaries: learned and blocked are [key,value] pairs in original insertion order
normalization.stateAdapter: vars(original instance), with only native format tag added; missing attributes remain missing
normalization.restoreAdapter: Fresh original instance then exact reconstruction of tuple keys, tuples and sets; source has no state/restore API
normalization.observations: Only source-read public fields; entities measured by original palette-neutral components on independent rows
normalization.frameHash: SHA256 of compact JSON rows, first 16 hex characters; deterministic synthetic public identifier
normalization.proposalsGuardsRecords: Complete returned objects and all state fields compared; no omitted identity/digest/result fields
normalization.rayCounterfactuals: Explicit synthetic hypotheses derived from the cold acquired state; never a fresh acquisition claim
normalization.boundedSearch: Original finite synthetic domains only; native resource-refusal policy tested separately
